headword: {在外公館|ざいがいこうかん}
gloss: diplomatic missions abroad; embassies and consulates

definitions.gloss: diplomatic missions abroad; embassies and consulates
definitions.explanation: A country's official offices in foreign countries, taken together: embassies, consulates general and consulates, and missions to international organizations. A formal word used by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and in the news.

examples.japanese: {在外公館|ざいがいこうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
examples.english: To contact the embassy or consulate.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくしたら、{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{在外公館|ざいがいこうかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you lose your passport, you go through the procedure at the nearest embassy or consulate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{在外公館|ざいがいこうかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{国政選挙|こくせいせんきょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese citizens living abroad can vote in national elections at Japan's embassies and consulates.

notes:
Made of ⟦{在外|ざいがい}→在外：32034_zaigai⟧ (located abroad) + {公館|こうかん} (official building). In everyday speech people name the specific office instead.

- ⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧: embassy (in the capital)
- ⟦{領事館|りょうじかん}→領事館：14757_ryoujikan⟧: consulate (in other cities)
